title: Brown Butter Crispy Rice Treats
description: Chewy, gooey marshmallow and crisp rice cereal squares made extra good with nutty browned butter and a pinch of salt.

image.alt: Squares of crispy rice cereal treats

steps.text: Butter the pan. Melt the butter in the pot over medium heat and keep cooking, swirling, until it smells nutty and turns golden brown with dark flecks, {time 4-5 min}.
Turn the heat to low, add the marshmallows and salt and stir until completely melted, {time 2-3 min}. Stir in the vanilla.
Take the pot off the heat, add the cereal and fold until evenly coated.
Press gently into the pan with buttered hands or a spatula; pressing hard makes them dense. Cool for {time 1 hr notimer} before cutting into squares.

notes: Most marshmallows contain gelatin, which comes from animals, so these aren’t labelled vegetarian. Vegan marshmallows work the same way.
Many rice cereals contain barley malt; look for a gluten-free brand if you need it.
